sources.title: fal-Krea-2-Style-LoRAs: Text-to-Image model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: Overview fal-Krea-2-Style-LoRAs is a collection of 1503 style Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) modules trained for Krea 2 Turbo, maintained by ilkerzgi. Each LoRA encodes a distinct visual style and can be applied to image generation by appending a style trigger phrase to your text prompt. sources.title: ilkerzgi Releases Over 1,500 Krea 2 Style LoRAs: A Massive Open-Source ...
sources.snippet: Community member ilkerzgi has released over 1,500 Krea 2 Style LoRAs on Hugging Face, making it one of the largest open-source style collections available for the model. Each LoRA comes with both original safetensors and ComfyUI-compatible versions, ready to use out of the box. The full collection is available at ilkerzgi/fal-Krea-2-Style-LoRAs.
